project.name: airness-governance
project.description:
The governance checks: what a repository holds, rather than what its code does. Commit message shape, typography, Javadoc links, comment prose, entry files, instruction references, dependency freshness, and the mutation baseline.
Every check is plain Java over an explicit repository root and explicit paths. Nothing here knows about Maven, which is what lets the same class run from a Mojo, from a git hook, or from a test. The Maven binding lives in airness-maven-plugin and is the only place that knows a build is happening at all.
